name: Smalltown Forest
author: Capz and AnimalTown contributors
description_short: A rolling village life game for the GameCube
description_long: Build a home, meet villagers and visit the town shop in a curved seasonal world. Standalone SD app; no AnimalTown disc required. Use SD2SP2 or Slot B SD Gecko for app files and a GameCube memory card in Slot A for settings and saves. Physical GC client installation and redistribution permission are still pending; this entry is a draft.

license.notes: Draft only. Original AnimalTown code and bundled assets need rights-holder terms and explicit Depot hosting permission. SDK and engine are GPL-2.0-only; bundled fonts retain their license. NOASSERTION does not grant redistribution permission.
